context: Two students fill out a club application form together
purpose: Teach: 申込/様式/分担/学期/人員/加える/細かく/穏やか

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この申込書、新学期から出す部活の様式で合ってるよね？
lines.en: This application form matches the club format for the new semester, right?
lines.style: Casual male university student, relaxed but checking details carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、合ってる。穏やかな顔してるけど、締切ギリギリじゃない？
lines.en: Yeah, it matches. You look calm, but isn't the deadline really close?
lines.style: Teasing teenage girl tone, light and playful with a hint of concern

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大丈夫、まだ間に合う。役割分担をここに書く欄があるみたい。
lines.en: It's fine, we still have time. Looks like there's a box here to write the role distribution.
lines.style: Reassuring male voice, slightly hurried but composed

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ私が会計で、先輩が部長ね。人員配置も細かく書いといて。
lines.en: Then I'll be treasurer and you'll be club president. Write out the staffing arrangement in detail too.
lines.style: Direct teenage girl, organizing decisively and bossing the senior around

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はいはい。あ、新入生を二人加えるって書いていい？
lines.en: Yes, yes. Oh, can I write that we're adding two new students?
lines.style: Mildly exasperated male student, going along with her instructions good-naturedly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいよ。去年は人員が足りなくて大変だったし、活動内容も少し加えるべき。
lines.en: Go ahead. We were short on members last year and struggled, and we should add a bit to the activity description too.
lines.style: Thoughtful teenage girl reflecting on past difficulties, practical and forward-looking

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学期末までに承認おりるかな。担当の先生、最近忙しそうだったし。
lines.en: I wonder if it'll be approved by the end of the term. The supervising teacher has seemed busy lately.
lines.style: Concerned male university student, voicing genuine worry about timing

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あの先生は穏やかだから、ちゃんと細かく説明すれば通してくれるよ。
lines.en: That teacher is gentle, so if we explain things carefully in detail, she'll approve it.
lines.style: Confident reassuring teenage girl, optimistic and warm in her assessment
